repair_note: Initial run failed before science due compiler-only report-order parameter type mismatch; source-only type repair was applied and the frozen preregistered experiment reran unchanged.

interpretation.plain_speak: The model can sometimes guess the missing value correctly after memory has already failed, but the guess does not follow a remapped truth. Change the value mapping and the lucky cells move. Correct output therefore cannot be trusted as proof that the dependency is still remembered.
interpretation.north_star_question: Establishes an important self-monitoring distinction: observable correctness can hide a real internal memory failure, so native recall state is a more faithful health signal than output accuracy at this boundary.
interpretation.next_stage: measure when the missing deferred dependency disappears from recall relative to when its later REPORT is requested, quantifying native-state warning lead time before observable capability loss
